name: Dakidarts Numerology Core
author: dakidarts

sections.description:
Dakidarts Numerology Core connects your WordPress site to the Dakidarts Numerology API. With this plugin, you can:

  • Use over 17 core numerology endpoints (life path, soul urge, personality number, personal year/month/day, and more)
  • Display interactive forms anywhere with shortcodes
  • Drag and drop Gutenberg blocks for easy page building
  • Customize templates for forms and results
  • Extend the plugin with category add-ons (Love, Career, Health, etc.)
  • Securely store your API key with AES-256 encryption
  • Fully translation-ready

Whether you’re a spiritual blogger or a numerology enthusiast, this plugin brings the power of the Dakidarts Numerology API directly to your WordPress site.

Third-Party Services

This plugin relies on the Dakidarts Numerology API, hosted via RapidAPI, to provide numerology calculations. Below are the details of the third-party service usage:

  • Service: Dakidarts Numerology API (via RapidAPI)
  • Purpose: Fetches numerology calculations (e.g., Life Path, Soul Urge, Personality Number) based on user inputs such as names or birth dates.
  • Data Sent: User-entered data (e.g., first name, last name, birth year, birth month, birth day) is sent to the API when a form is submitted via shortcodes or Gutenberg blocks. No data is sent without user interaction.
  • When Data is Sent: Data is sent only when a user submits a numerology form on the frontend (e.g., via [dakidarts_numerology endpoint="life-path"] or a Gutenberg block).
  • Privacy and Terms:
    • RapidAPI Privacy Policy: https://rapidapi.com/page/privacy/
    • RapidAPI Terms of Use: https://rapidapi.com/page/terms/
    • Dakidarts API Documentation: https://dakidarts.com/api/the-numerology-api/
  • Consent: Users must explicitly submit forms to send data to the API. No tracking or automatic data collection occurs.

The plugin does not store or process personal data beyond what is required for API requests, and the API key is securely encrypted using AES-256 before storage.

Arbitrary Section

For more info and API documentation, visit: https://dakidarts.com/api/the-numerology-api/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dakidarts-numerology-core folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Dakidarts Numerology > Settings in the admin dashboard and enter your RapidAPI key.
  4. Use shortcodes like [dakidarts_numerology endpoint="life-path"] or drag & drop the Gutenberg blocks onto any page.
  5. Customize templates and styling as needed.
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin without an API key?

No. You need a valid RapidAPI key to fetch numerology data.

Can I create my own templates?

Yes! You can override the default templates by copying them into your theme or add-on folders.

Are my API keys stored securely?

Yes. The plugin encrypts the API key using AES-256 before storing it in the database.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Absolutely. The plugin includes custom Gutenberg blocks for easy drag & drop usage.
